inlines.v: HYPERBOL'ICAL, n. Belonging to the hyperbola; having the nature of the hyperbola. 1. Relating to or containing hyperbole; exaggerating or diminishing beyond the fact; exceeding the truth; as a hyperbolical expression. Hyperbolic space, in geometry, the space or content comprehended between the curve of a hyperbole and the whole ordinate.
